audit.back_translation: The UK location includes England, Scotland and Wales, not Northern Ireland. Use average weekly salary from the weeks 12 prior to the notice of termination and enter it in GBP. This simplified estimate only covers the end date of employment from 6 April 2026; it counts all years of employment backwards from the specified date and applies the £751 weekly salary cap, up to 20 years of employment and the age ranges described by GOV.UK. Termination rules or other circumstances may change the statutory relevant date.
